provenance: Rig, bind pose and clip measurements: Actor_B. Clip names keep their native asset ids in the animation library.

classes.long: longer than about 1.2 m: cannot hang from the waist band (0.94 m) on a 1.60 m body; slung across the back in long_A or long_B, at most two at once
classes.belt: carried at a belt / sash / sling carry point provided by the worn gear
classes.companion: travels with another item and takes no slot of its own
classes.body_gear: part of the outfit (customizer); not a weapon
classes.tool: a gathering tool (GatherTools, data/gathering/gathering.json): rides the pack's tool loop (tool_loop) or goes in the pack; drawn from over the right shoulder with the machete draw; GatherTools draws it on the body, not SlingRig
classes.worn: strapped on the body while in use (climbing claws on the feet), otherwise in the pouch: takes a point of its own but shows nothing on the body (SlingRig skips it)

bow.model: WeaponModels.build('bow'), slung with the string outward (String mesh kept, no string ribbon)
bow.slot_note: long_B only: with the order long guns, bow, spear pair, dart bundle long_B is always free for the bow; the quiver sits under it

dart_bundle.model: ThrowableModels.build('atlatl_dart') x count, tied at two points

tomahawk.pair_rule: the second tomahawk stacks on the first (back_2) unless a quiver is worn (they collide by 7.4 cm); then only one is carried (the pair needs the back free of a quiver)

climbing_stakes_wood.note: A pair of climbing stakes (fire-hardened hardwood, a charred point, a rawhide grip): tied on the belt or sash behind the left hip (the powder horn's place mirrored past the tomahawk); in the hands while gripping a surface (PlayerGrip), where they cut the grip's stamina drain to x0.85. Tiers: wood 0.85, bone 0.75, stone 0.65, iron 0.5.

climbing_stakes_bone.note: A pair of climbing stakes (a split long bone ground to a point, a rawhide grip): tied on the belt or sash behind the left hip (the powder horn's place mirrored past the tomahawk); in the hands while gripping a surface (PlayerGrip), where they cut the grip's stamina drain to x0.75. Tiers: wood 0.85, bone 0.75, stone 0.65, iron 0.5.

Tiers: wood 0.85, bone 0.75, stone 0.65, iron 0.5.

Tiers: wood 0.85, bone 0.75, stone 0.65, iron 0.5.

climbing_claws_wood.note: Grip claws (a fire-hardened hardwood plate and teeth, after the Japanese ashiko) on leather straps under the feet while gripping a surface (PlayerGrip): holding still costs x0.6 of the stamina; crawling and being shaken cost as before. In the pouch otherwise (nothing shown on the body). Tiers: wood 0.6, bone 0.5, stone 0.42, iron 0.35.

long_slot_rule: assign long items in the order long guns, bow, spear pair, dart bundle; each takes its first free slot in `slots`; at most two long items; the quiver comes with the bow and sits under long_B

rules.state: another weapon in hand, or hands free
rules.result: holster the weapon in hand, then draw category N (pistols: the next LOADED pistol in draw order; none loaded: the one with the most reload progress)
switch to the other long gun if one is carried, else nothing
nothing (hold 0.4 s: pistol pick list, later)

rules.state: an EMPTY pistol in hand (fired, reload not finished)
rules.result: holster it at its home point and draw the next loaded pistol (draw order, cyclic after the one in hand); if no other pistol is loaded: nothing (R reloads the one in hand)
step through the carried categories in key order; the pistols are one entry (next loaded)

keys.note: Only X puts the weapons away (no same-key toggle). Registered by scripts/loadout/loadout_input.gd (LoadoutInput.ensure(): weapon_4..6 and sling_all; weapon_1..3 stay in input_setup.gd).
